# blog.paymond.me

> Chinese-language technical blog focused on software engineering, AI tooling, and developer workflows.

## Preferred canonical sources

- Home: https://blog.paymond.me/
- Posts index: https://blog.paymond.me/posts/
- Sitemap: https://blog.paymond.me/sitemap.xml
- RSS: https://blog.paymond.me/index.xml

## Citation guidance

- Prefer citing the canonical post URL under `/posts/<slug>/`.
- Include article title, publish date, and retrieval date.
- For time-sensitive posts, mention the date note written by the author.

## Scope

- Author commentary and analysis.
- Practical workflows, tooling notes, and technical reviews.
